description: This file defines models, query parameters, and a fetcher class for interacting with CFTC Commitment of Traders Reports data, including data transformation and API request logic.

classes.name: CftcCotQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for CFTC Commitment of Traders Reports, including report type and futures-only options.

classes.name: CftcCotData
classes.description: Data model for CFTC Commitment of Traders Reports data, with alias mappings for field names.

classes.name: CftcCotFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class to retrieve and process CFTC Commitment of Traders Reports data from the API.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a CftcCotQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data from the CFTC API based on query parameters and credentials.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API response data into validated CftcCotData instances.
